{{Top|leg}}
The '''Rentean shipbuilding facility''' was located on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rentean]], and manufactured [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. It was [[Battle of Rentean|attacked]] by agents of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
